messages:
anya (PM): heads-up — got a firm ask from AtlasHealth (enterprise) to accelerate Private KMS + audit logs. they want onboarding in ~6 weeks, otherwise they pull the pilot. need quick reforecast for q2 okrs.

marcus (Sales): +1 urgent. they committed to a multi-region pilot and talked ARR if we hit compliance gate. i have legal looped.

raj (ENG): 6 weeks is tight. KMS integration + key rotation + e2e test matrix across on-prem and vpc will touch runtime and private installer. rough effort: 3 engs full-time for 4–6 wks to deliver a safe GA.

anya (PM): options on table: a) pull Optimize perf work to q3 and reassign 3 engs, b) add contractors to keep both, c) scope down KMS to limited features for pilot (no auto-rotation). pros/cons?

sophie (Design): for the pilot we can ship a pared-down UX: only key import + view audit trail, hide rotation UI until GA. keeps surface area small.

oliver (SRE): need to confirm kms provider matrix (aws/kms, gcp/kms, vault). also we must add telemetry for key usage and a retention policy for audit logs. storage + retention could affect infra costs — estimate +10% infra for 3 months.

anya (PM): @elaine deciding point: do we reprioritize OKRs mid-q (reduce Optimize completion target) or push back pilot timeline? i'm leaning to reprioritize given revenue.

elaine (VP Product): show me numbers — revenue risk vs. objective regression. what are the measurable okr deltas if we shift?

anya (PM): current OKRs: "Optimize: unit-cost -15%" (0.8 target), "Private: enterprise readiness" (0.7 target). proposal: reduce Optimize target to 0.5 (move perf experiments to q3), raise Private readiness to 0.9 by scoping features for pilot.

marcus (Sales): if we hit pilot gate, we convert to enterprise contract forecasting ~ $600k ARR within 12 months. atlashealth said this is the deciding factor.

raj (ENG): technical acceptance criteria for pilot (proposed):
```
- KMS: import customer-managed key (RSA or AES) in installer
- audit logs: immutable append-only log exported to customer S3/GCS for retention 90d
- RBAC: restrict key usage to inference nodes only
- e2e: simulated failover and key rotation dry-run (no auto-rotate for pilot)
```

anya (PM): rollout plan (short):
1) week 1: spec + infra prep + security review
2) week 2–4: implementation tasks (eng)
3) week 5: internal beta with SRE + security
4) week 6: customer pilot with AtlasHealth; gather feedback

oliver (SRE): i'll reserve a canary pool and add monitoring dashboards. ops-bot linked CI board: https://go/boards/infra/1769 — scheduling now.

ops-bot (bot): New card created: "Private KMS pilot - atlashealth" assigned to raj, oliver, anya. ETA 2026-05-08.

elaine (VP Product): ok i'm leaning to approve reprioritization. two asks before i sign-off: 1) commit matrix of OKR score changes, 2) impact on hosted roadmap (are we delaying any customer-visible hosting features?).

anya (PM): matrix:
- Optimize unit-cost OKR: target -> 0.5 (was 0.8)
- Private enterprise readiness OKR: target -> 0.9 (was 0.7)
- Score justification added to the OKR doc (link: https://go/okrs/q2-reforecast)

raj (ENG): hosted roadmap impact: we postpone "continuous-prefix caching v2" (low risk for hosted customers) and keep critical bugfix rollouts. no SLA changes.

sophie (Design): small UX compromise for pilot documented; will iterate post-pilot.

elaine (VP Product): thanks. i approve the mid-quarter adjustment. please update OKR doc and notify leadership. i want weekly check-ins until pilot completes. +:thumbsup:

marcus (Sales): i'll tell AtlasHealth we have executive sign-off and share expected dates. thanks team.

anya (PM): updating docs now and scheduling weekly standups. tagging security for audit checklist.

oliver (SRE): creating monitoring runbook + playbook for key compromise scenarios.

anya (PM): summary: reprioritize q2 to accelerate Private KMS pilot for AtlasHealth, move Optimize perf experiments to q3, enforce pilot acceptance criteria, executive sign-off obtained. next: weekly sync calendar invite to follow. :sparkles:
